about.summary: I'm a Mid-Level Flutter Developer and team lead based in Damascus, currently working remotely with Akwad in Qatar. For nearly 5 years I've designed and shipped production-grade iOS & Android apps using Clean Architecture, SOLID principles and modern state management.
